units.source_text:
Broad staging view. The radio station placed in Chapter 9 is being used. The outside operator stands at it, not waiting for the visitors. Nib watches from beside Taeo, safely south of the barrier. Minho is near enough for ordinary conversation, his body turned toward the operator's working area.

OPERATOR: Reception lane's clear.

MINHO: Keep that side open.

The distant active threshold remains background context. No fresh spectacle or repeated landscape comparison.

Taeo takes a hand out of his jacket pocket. He looks toward the station rather than the gate, trying to find an actual task in all the work around them.

TAEO: If Nib goes in, could I tell you what I feel?

MINHO: What have you felt?

An inquiry, without agreement to a crossing yet.

lines.text: If Nib goes in, could I tell you what I feel?

units.source_text:
Taeo lets his LEFT fingers uncurl. He addresses Minho; Nib listens beside him rather than being demonstrated on demand.

TAEO: Pressure here. I felt it twice with Chae. Then I missed one.

MINHO: And since then?

TAEO: We haven't tried again.

He does not hide the office failure or claim unseen practice.

lines.text: Pressure here. I felt it twice with Chae. Then I missed one.

units.source_text:
One compact phone-and-faces composition. Taeo has opened the public beginner practice section of the ordinary assessment-office information page he used in Chapter 1. The phone is in his RIGHT hand. On it, a cropped silent construct forearm rests on an ordinary exercise pad; beside it, its summoner's gloved hand relaxes. Only enough of this original clip appears to explain why Taeo unclenches his own hand. No magical overlay or new response is demonstrated on Taeo.

CLIP VOICE: Relax your hand. Wait for a change.

Nib looks at Taeo's actual empty hand, not reverently at the phone. The clip is finished with this unit; do not make it a lecture, an elite cameo or an explanation of the link.

lines.text: Relax your hand. Wait for a change.

units.source_text:
Taeo closes and pockets the phone in his jacket with his RIGHT hand before proposing anything. Both hands are now empty.

TAEO: Could we try out here? With me turned away.

Nib looks at the clear recess, then at Minho.

NIB: What am I pressing?

MINHO: Something that stays put. I'll watch.

Nib steps toward the indicated safe space by his own choice. No command pose or magical agreement effect.

lines.text: Could we try out here? With me turned away.
Something that stays put. I'll watch.

units.source_text:
Compact setup view. Minho finishes setting three low padded supports in the west-side recess. He presses a base sideways with his boot; it remains stable. Nib runs his LEFT fingertips over the soft top of the middle support to check its surface. His RIGHT hand stays clear. Taeo stands south of them, able to see the setup before turning away.

MINHO: Just a gentle press. Stop whenever you want.

NIB: All right.

Minho takes a small ordinary note card and pencil from his pocket after the supports are placed. Card in LEFT hand, silent cue or pencil in RIGHT. No clipboard computer or measurement device.

lines.text: Just a gentle press. Stop whenever you want.

units.source_text:
A single orienting side view gives the test positions defined above. Taeo turns to face SOUTH. His LEFT palm is empty and relaxed beside him, his RIGHT hand also empty. Nib faces his back across the pad row, RIGHT hand ready but not yet touching. Minho remains east of Nib, out of Taeo's view.

MINHO: Say when you feel something. Don't guess which one.

Taeo nods without looking around. No blindfold, restraint or transmitted private instruction.

lines.text: Say when you feel something. Don't guess which one.

units.source_text:
Minho silently points toward the WEST support. Nib applies his RIGHT palm gently to its pad. Both feet stay on the ground; his shoulder stays low and unstrained. The pad indents slightly. Taeo's back is visible farther south.

No dialogue. This is the first tested press. No strike, glow, cord or impression appears in Taeo's palm.

Taeo looks down at his empty LEFT palm without turning toward the test. His fingers loosen a fraction; nothing in the hand moves or bears weight.

TAEO: There.

Keep it a faint subjective report. Do not render a visible force, handprint or pain reaction.

Continue in a small connected release beat within the same acting unit, without a separate portrait.
Minho's flat hand ends the press; Nib lifts his RIGHT palm. The west pad recovers its shape. Taeo remains facing away.

TAEO: Gone.

Minho makes a small private mark. Its writing is not reader text or a score display.

A small wide beat keeps all three pads and the open space under Nib's RIGHT palm visible. Minho holds the wait cue. Nib deliberately touches none of the supports. Taeo waits with the same empty LEFT hand, saying nothing.

No dialogue, timer or suspense lettering. This untouched interval is correctly quiet; it is not a hidden press that the art forgot.

After a nonuniform interval, Minho silently indicates the EAST support. Nib gently presses that pad with his RIGHT palm. Taeo, still facing away, raises his chin a little when the faint sensation arrives.

TAEO: There again.

The viewer can see the actual pad. Taeo names no position, material or action beyond the sensation.

Continue in a compact connected release beat; keep this faster than the first report.
Nib releases at Minho's silent flat-hand cue. The east pad returns to shape. Taeo's mouth lifts at one corner before he can suppress it.

TAEO: Gone.

Minho adds another private mark. He offers no praise, running percentage or signal that all testing is finished.

Minho silently indicates the MIDDLE support. Nib's RIGHT palm presses the pad gently, to the same modest visible indentation as before. His wrist is neutral. The other two pads remain untouched.

No dialogue. This is the final tested press. Taeo cannot see the cue or contact; there is no extra press between this and the miss.

Taeo is already expecting the familiar feeling. His eyes drop to the still-empty LEFT palm. That tiny half-smile fades while he waits. The middle pad is still indented beneath Nib's RIGHT palm in an honest background sight line or a connected upper inset.

TAEO: Nothing yet.

Do not depict pressure arriving late. No harder press, tingling SFX, panic or covert injury.

Minho gives the flat-hand cue. Nib lifts his RIGHT palm and lets the middle pad recover, without increasing the pressure. The comparison is over.

MINHO: That's enough. Turn round.

Taeo turns only after contact has ended.

Taeo starts to look for another moment, his body angled halfway back toward his former position. Nib's arms are down now. He looks directly up at Taeo, dry and matter-of-fact.

TAEO: If we give it a little—

NIB: I was already pressing.

No anger speech and no comic humiliation. Nib refuses a comforting re-description of what happened.

lines.text: If we give it a little—

units.source_text:
Taeo stops turning away. He looks at the middle support, then at Nib. His LEFT hand lowers fully.

TAEO: And I didn't feel it.

He says it to the person who was pressing, without trying again. Minho folds the note card, ending the test as an action rather than leaving another round pending.

Taeo turns to Minho. He still wants a place in the work; admitting the miss has not erased that.

TAEO: Could still be an extra warning.

MINHO: Extra. We won't wait for it.

No promise of reliability, field qualification or a mechanism behind the failures.

lines.text: Could still be an extra warning.
Extra. We won't wait for it.

units.source_text:
The working channel cuts through their conversation. Minho presses the talk control of the radio still clipped high at his LEFT chest with his RIGHT hand, then releases before listening. They are in the recess beside the equipment lane, not blocking it; he wants them clear before traffic passes.

OPERATOR, RADIO: Minho. Equipment coming through southwest.

MINHO, RADIO: Hold it. We're clearing this side.

Nib looks toward the real access lane. This is routine movement, not a manufactured emergency.

lines.text: Hold it. We're clearing this side.

units.source_text:
One flowing transition with a clear set-down beat. Minho puts his folded card and pencil back into his jacket, leaving both hands free. He carries two of the lightweight supports to the adjacent side rack; Taeo carries the remaining one with both hands. They set all three flat on that rack, off the walkway. Nib moves clear without being asked to carry a human-sized stack. Minho's radio stays clipped and unobstructed; nobody transmits while carrying.

No dialogue. The supports remain ordinary objects; the station itself does not move again.

Minho is now hands-free at the rack. He presses and releases his clipped radio control. A licensed crew member, using the Chapter 9 incidental model, waits at the southwest access with an ordinary equipment bag; they move only after the answer. Keep the bag modest, with no mysterious payload or new tool close-up.

MINHO, RADIO: Clear now. Send it.

OPERATOR, RADIO: Moving to the station.

The crew member crosses the equipment lane toward the southern station without entering the southeast reception lane or the gate. This is the paid crew doing its normal work.

Nib watches the crew member pass into the station area, then addresses Minho. Taeo stands beside them, thumb no longer searching his own palm.

NIB: What do I hear when you want us out?

MINHO: My voice. We practice that before you go anywhere.

The question changes the next practical action. No second maze, cart exercise or deliberate radio failure.

lines.text: What do I hear when you want us out?
My voice. We practice that before you go anywhere.

units.source_text:
Minho turns toward the south bay's preparation space, safely on this side of the barrier. Nib follows his gaze. Taeo remains nearer the station.

MINHO: If we do this, I go with you. Just inside, straight back. After the exit briefing and your kit.

NIB: Then show me what to say.

This is conditional agreement to a supervised short trial. The exit briefing, fitted vest/footwear, approved apron and parent-reviewed gate rule still belong to Chapter 11. Nib has not crossed or accepted a survey job.

lines.text: If we do this, I go with you. Just inside, straight back. After the exit briefing and your kit.
Then show me what to say.

units.source_text:
At the station, the outside operator hands Nib the established ochre-marked handheld into his LEFT hand and Taeo the distinct pale-blue-marked handset into his RIGHT, one exchange after the other. Taeo's phone remains pocketed. Minho stands at the near edge of the same safe preparation space.

MINHO: When I call withdrawal, say where you're going. Then come with me.

NIB: If this goes quiet?

MINHO: We stop the trial and walk back together.

Nib looks from his actual handset to Minho beside him. This is a spoken lost-radio default for a paired trial, not a claim of contact through all gates or a new automatic rescue mechanism.

lines.text: When I call withdrawal, say where you're going. Then come with me.
We stop the trial and walk back together.

units.source_text:
The operator indicates a place beside the console, clear of their own controls. Taeo steps to it, holding the advisory handset in his RIGHT hand. His LEFT remains empty. He is at the operator's side rather than taking the central position.

OPERATOR: Taeo, beside me. Only report what you notice.

TAEO: All right.

The handset does not confer a credential or control of the working channel.

lines.text: Taeo, beside me. Only report what you notice.

units.source_text:
Minho and Nib walk a few paces EAST within the southern staging bay to the preparation position. The barrier remains NORTH of them, distant enough that no portal edge touches their silhouettes. They remain in ordinary speaking and radio range. Nib keeps the radio in his LEFT hand, RIGHT empty at his side; personal blade sheathed LEFT and pouch tied RIGHT. Minho begins to turn back toward the station with him.

No dialogue. This changes their actual positions for a single walking rehearsal; no cones, blind route or imagined dungeon obstacle.

Minho presses his clipped radio's talk control with his RIGHT hand, looking at Nib beside him as well as speaking into it.

MINHO, RADIO: Nib, withdraw with me. Back to staging.

He releases the button before Nib answers. The voice reaches both assigned handsets through ordinary equipment; no magical emphasis.

lines.text: Nib, withdraw with me. Back to staging.

units.source_text:
Nib presses his LEFT-hand radio button after Minho's transmission ends.

NIB, RADIO: With you. Back to staging.

He releases it and turns with Minho, matching his own shorter stride instead of running to catch up. He can be heard by Taeo and the outside operator.

A broad short walking beat. Nib and Minho come back WEST to the station together along the same clear southern-bay path. The ordinary barrier and threshold stay north in the background. Taeo watches the pair while holding his RIGHT-hand radio with his thumb clear of the button. His empty LEFT hand is relaxed. He does not offer a phantom report or guide the walk.

No dialogue. The result is people arriving where they said they would go, not a game score or echo of the Chapter 6 cart reveal.

The pair stop in the station's clear standing area. Nib lifts his LEFT-hand radio and gives the short completed-action report, then releases. The operator sees both people directly before replying through the station microphone.

NIB, RADIO: Nib and Minho at staging.

OPERATOR, RADIO: Both seen.

One call, one repeat, actual movement, arrival report and visual confirmation complete the routine. No further drill is needed here.

Minho takes the folded note card back out in his LEFT hand and the pencil in his RIGHT. Nib lowers his radio but keeps it in his LEFT hand. The operator stays at work. Minho asks Taeo while all three remain within the staging area.

MINHO: Between those first two presses, I had him touch nothing. What did you get?

TAEO: I felt those two. Nothing in between. And I missed the last one.

Taeo is reporting the now-disclosed comparison, not claiming he identified the untouched support or press positions while blinded.

lines.text: Between those first two presses, I had him touch nothing. What did you get?
I felt those two. Nothing in between. And I missed the last one.

units.source_text:
Taeo meets Minho's eyes, then looks at the operator's station. His RIGHT-hand handset rests at his side; his LEFT hand is empty.

TAEO: Put the miss in, too.

Minho adds the final plain mark and pockets card and pencil again before moving on.

MINHO: We'll use the radio to bring him back.

Taeo nods. No congratulation, rank verdict or promise that the next attempt will work.

lines.text: We'll use the radio to bring him back.

units.source_text:
Final broad working composition. Taeo stands beside the outside operator, leaving the console and field decisions to them. Nib stands with Minho at the station's preparation side, still barefoot in his existing clothes, ochre radio in LEFT hand. His RIGHT palm is empty and at rest. The three padded supports are visible on their side rack, no fourth support or new test pending. Minho's radio remains at LEFT chest.

OPERATOR, RADIO: Staging ready.

The actual threshold is distant beyond the north barrier. Everyone in this chapter remains outside. Finish on the station functioning and Taeo taking his place in it. No glow, mystery pulse, monster teaser, money exchange, kit appearing offscreen or departure through the gate.
